stage1.impression: A wide, symmetrical view down a listening bar toward a record wall, but the light is flat and over-bright for night, and the cast is greenish-grey. The ceiling is mottled, with two clipped blobs. A third of the frame is empty grey floor, and eight identical leather swivel chairs repeat across the middle. The tinted-acrylic speakers are small, dim red and blue shapes that you have to hunt for, and nothing glows the way acrylic should. It reads as an architectural CG walkthrough, not a magazine interior.

blocking_9: The frame reads as night: a full-frame median of about 60-80, with the room lit by its own acrylic glow rather than by an even ambient wash
Every tinted speaker reads at a glance as a luminous coloured object, clearly brighter and more saturated than the wall behind it
The ceiling membrane is an even, soft glow, with no mottling and no clipped hotspots
A neutral white balance: the walls are warm-neutral, not green-grey
The floor carries reflections of the coloured sources and is not a flat grey void
Signs of life (guests, a bartender, objects in use) that break up the repeated chair models and give scale
Visible atmosphere: a soft haze that shows the cones of the spots and separates foreground, lounge and record wall into depth

defects.what: Ceiling hotspot clips (4.2%), a hard blob on the membrane
Ceiling membrane mottled and blotchy, with a noisy salt texture and uneven wavy pools; reads as a denoiser artefact or bad emission
Left wall over-bright (median 191) and green-white (g 194 > r 187); the brightest mass in the frame, it competes with the room
A large empty, flat grey floor (median 137) with weak blurry reflections, a third of the frame with no content
Eight identical swivel chairs in a row read as instanced copies; the leather has CG plastic highlights
Red speaker at the bar end is tiny and reads as opaque red plastic, not tinted acrylic with a glow
Red speaker on the right is dim (median 64) and swallowed by the violet slats
The screen in the record wall is a flat cyan rectangle (r 38, g 89, b 98) that pulls the eye from the products
Saturated blue edge light (b 233) at the left frame edge, an unexplained colour spill
Bar stools cropped at the left edge and the foreground stool cut in half
No people, no props in use: the room reads as an empty CG set

changes.problem: The frame is far too bright and flat to read as a bar at night.

evidence.measured: lum_mean 113.9, p50 118; only 14% of pixels below 40; the left wall at a median of 191

changes.expected: The full-frame median falls to about 65; the glowing sources (slats, panels, shelves, speakers) become the brightest things and the walls fall into shadow.

changes.problem: The membrane has two clipped hotspots and a mottled, noisy surface that reads as CG.

evidence.measured: clip 4.2% at the left pool and 4.7% at the right pool (800,110-920,160); the ceiling's lum_range is 68 with visible blotches

change.setting: the wash behind each pair (4 x spot) and the membrane
change.to: wash 90 W, cone 50 deg, aimed below the ceiling line onto the pairs; membrane 0.004, with samples raised to 512 or the ceiling's denoise prefiltering set to accurate

changes.expected: The ceiling is an even, dim, warm glow with no blobs, and the pools land on the speakers instead of on the ceiling.

changes.problem: The speakers, the products this frame sells, are dim and read as opaque plastic rather than lit acrylic.

evidence.measured: the right red speaker at a median of 64 against the slats beside it at 142; the bar-end speaker at a median of 111 against a wall at 191

change.setting: lamps on each corner speaker (4 x area); on each Fog speaker (2 x spot)
change.to: 18.0 W/m2, placed behind and inside each cabinet to back-light the batts through the acrylic; 220 W

changes.expected: Each speaker glows in its own colour and is the brightest coloured object in its zone, even after the exposure cut in c1.

changes.problem: The grade is green-grey, which reads as institutional rather than a warm kissa at night.

evidence.measured: left wall g_median 194 > r_median 187; the ceiling's r/g/b medians are 148/121/101, so the two disagree

changes.expected: The walls go warm-neutral (r >= g), the acrylic colours stay true, and the left wall stops reading as green.

changes.problem: The floor is a bright, flat, empty grey that takes a third of the frame and carries no colour from the room.

evidence.measured: lum_median 137, p5 87; the falloff profile is flat (127-148), with no coloured reflections

change.to: dark honed charcoal concrete (albedo about 0.08), roughness 0.18, with fine aggregate and trowel micro-variation, so it mirrors the bar panels, the slats and the speakers in long soft streaks

changes.expected: The floor drops to a median of about 40-60, with coloured streaks under the bar panels and the violet slats, and it leads the eye to the record wall.

changes.problem: With no people, the room is an empty CG set, and the eight identical chairs read as instanced copies.

evidence.measured: seen: eight chairs with identical pose, creases and highlights

change.to: four seated guests in the lounge chairs (dark clothing, some motion blur at 1/15 s), a bartender behind the bar at the left, a coat over one stool, two chairs rotated 10-25 deg off axis, with varied leather wear

changes.expected: The room reads at human scale and in use; the repetition breaks, and the dark figures silhouette against the record wall.

changes.problem: The air has no atmosphere, so the depth from the door to the record wall flattens.

evidence.measured: the record wall's lum_range is 197, as contrasty as the foreground, with no aerial falloff and no visible spot cones

change.setting: haze in the room's air: density / anisotropy

changes.expected: Soft cones under the spots and the Bells, a gentle veil on the record wall (p5 rises), and the foreground separates from the background.

changes.problem: The camera gives a third of the frame to empty floor, and it crops the foreground stools at the edge.

evidence.measured: seen: half a stool at the left edge; the floor runs from y 530 to 800 with nothing on it

changes.expected: The horizon sits near the middle third, less floor and more of the lit room; the stools are whole or clearly out of frame.

out_of_scope.request: Make the speakers larger or more prominent in the frame
out_of_scope.why: Their size (1293 mm) and placement are fixed; from the door of an 18 m room they will always be small, so a tighter companion shot should carry the product

out_of_scope.request: Dim or recolour the cyan screen in the record wall
out_of_scope.why: The screens are part of the fixed room design; only their emission level may change, so lower it if the card allows it as a source
The lounge layout is fixed; only the upholstery material and props may vary (see c6)
